full_page.content:
c. 1954, September 9
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
POSTCARD
ZAUTOGRAPH ON BACK OF A PHOTO
St. Felix, Huntington, Ind. Sept. 9th 1954
Blessed be God in all His designs. God bless you Dear Father Venantius. many thanks for your practical rememberance of our Jubilee here July 24. God willing, I surely hope to see you have that privileged distinction in just a
few years more - yourself
and Fr. Boniface Glory be to God! We certainly had a happy - in a way - an unique celebration.
Our Monastery Chapel of course was too small for anything of that kind. Thanks be to God - and to our two neighbor - pastors we had an ideal set-up . Solemn Mass in St. Mary - Irish Parish with a German Pastor - Miller - and the dinner - breakfast (about 300) in SS. Peter and Paul's School Auditorium - Father Schmitz the Pastor. The two have a High School together . One could only wonder at the doctrine there manifest - communion of saints.
Pl. pardon brevity - 10 40 p.m.
Fr. Solanus, O. F.M.C.
